title: Arithmetic bound for circuit size
statement:
For every natural number $n$,
\[
(n+1)\bigl(2n+4\cdot 2^{\,n-(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor-1)}+2\cdot 2^{\,\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor-1}+2^{\,2^{\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor-1}}\bigr)\le 40\cdot 2^n,
\]
where the subtractions and logarithm are interpreted as natural-number operations, with $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ denoting the base-two integer logarithm.
